stem: A pharmacist compares Syndros oral solution with Marinol capsules. Select all rules that apply to Syndros.

choices.text: A Schedule II prescription for Syndros may not be refilled.
Syndros follows the Schedule III refill rule used for Marinol.
The Massachusetts 30-day Schedule II validity period applies.
Its liquid dosage form makes it Schedule VI.
An unused refill remains valid for six months.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. Federal law prohibits refilling a Schedule II prescription; additional dispensing requires a new lawful prescription or a permitted remainder of a partial fill. A Massachusetts written or electronic Schedule II prescription becomes invalid 30 days after its issue date. dronabinol oral solution (Syndros) is used for chemotherapy-associated nausea and vomiting and aids-related anorexia. It is federal Schedule II and Massachusetts Schedule II; its legal consequence in this scenario follows the cited schedule-specific rule.
